# Keepsake

> Keepsake is a free marketplace for giving away sentimental objects — photos, books, jewelry, and
> other things worth a second life — rather than throwing them out. Givers post a photo and a
> story; people who want the item ask for it, and the giver chooses. No passwords, no payments
> and no shipping fees to the platform — an email address is all either side is asked for.

## Key pages

- [Browse the feed](https://keepsake.ing/): everything currently available to request.
- [What Keepsake is](https://keepsake.ing/welcome): the explainer — the same card a first visit to the home page shows.
- [Give something](https://keepsake.ing/give): start listing an object.
- [About](https://keepsake.ing/about): who built this and why.
